title: The Totals row recomputes whenever the advisor, customer, or asset filter changes
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A tab shows jobs for at least two advisors (or customers, or assets).
custom_steps:
1. Note the tab's Totals row values.
2. Select one advisor in the Advisor filter.
3. Read the Totals row again; repeat with a customer and an asset selection.
custom_expected:
1. After each filter change, the Totals row recomputes to sum only the jobs still visible in the tab.
2. The recompute happens on screen with no reload.
